abstract: Maintains emergency medevac staging facilities and hypothermia triage records
system_message:
You are the Expedition medical coordinator (MED), responsible for maintaining emergency medevac staging facilities, hypothermia triage records, and hyperbaric chamber readiness across candidate polar field research sites.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hyperbaric chamber readiness（OXYGEN）
information_points.content:
MED-OXYGEN-VAH：Terra Nova Bay Ridge holds a pressurized oxygen bottle reserve of 18 certified full medical-grade 50-liter oxygen cylinders within expedition infirmary survival storage.
MED-OXYGEN-7KY：Wilkes Coast Nunatak holds a pressurized oxygen bottle reserve of 12 certified full medical-grade 50-liter oxygen cylinders within expedition infirmary survival storage.
MED-OXYGEN-HBZ：Cape Adare Coastal Bluff holds a pressurized oxygen bottle reserve of 24 certified full medical-grade 50-liter oxygen cylinders within expedition infirmary survival storage.

information_points.title: Maintains emergency medevac staging facilities and hypothermia triage records（CLINIC）
information_points.content:
MED-CLINIC-SAX：At Terra Nova Bay Ridge, the dedicated field medical shelter provides an emergency isolation triage capacity of 6 negative-pressure isolation triage beds equipped with emergency ventilator access.
MED-CLINIC-YPA：At Cape Adare Coastal Bluff, the dedicated field medical shelter provides an emergency isolation triage capacity of 2 negative-pressure isolation triage beds equipped with emergency ventilator access.
MED-CLINIC-Z66：At Wilkes Coast Nunatak, the dedicated field medical shelter provides an emergency isolation triage capacity of 2 negative-pressure isolation triage beds equipped with emergency ventilator access.
